crewNotes.text: General Hong Kong traveller concessions; note the low 19-cigarette tobacco allowance. Crew should confirm any crew-specific treatment. Compiled from the cited HK Customs & Excise guidance, pending final authority review.

rules.text: A passenger aged 18 or over may bring in 1 litre of alcoholic liquor with strength above 30% ABV, for personal use (HK ID holders must have spent 24 hours or more outside Hong Kong).

declarationRequirements.text: Hong Kong is a free port; most goods are duty-free. Only liquor, tobacco, hydrocarbon oil and methyl alcohol are dutiable and subject to the concessions above.

rules.text: Tobacco allowance is 19 cigarettes, or 1 cigar, or 25g of other tobacco, per person.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.

sources.authorityName: Hong Kong Customs and Excise Department
